newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Endesa to take part in Retevision's sale.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Endesa to take part in Retevision's sale.

text.p: Spanish electricity company Empresa Nacional de Electricitad, Endesa said on Wednesday it would take part in the upcoming privatisation of telecomunications firm Retevision.
"It's likely that we'll be in the telecommunications business, in the auction for the Retevision privatisation," Endesa chairman Rodolfo Martin Villa told an industry commission.
Villa explained that Endesa, as a public firm, "has to cooperate with the privatisation of Retevision, so long as it does not interfere with our economic results."
Retevision, expected to operate as Spain's second domestic telephone operator after Telefonica, announced on Tuesday the terms for privatisation of a 60 percent stake in a restricted auction.
The states initial sale of 60 percent comprises 2.4 million shares out of a total of 4.0 million shares and will be offered at a minimum price of 45.6 billion pesetas.
The prospective buyer must make a commitment to underwrite another 10 percent capital increase in Retevision, a company statement said.

Given a minimum price of 19,000 pesetas per share, the commitment would mean a further expenditure of 25.33 billion pesetas. After the capital increase, the state will remain with a diluted 30 percent stake.
